refresh.description: The button that fetches the current folder again.

search.description: The placeholder of the browser's search, which searches the folder the browser stands in.

text.description: The label of the search's text literal: the option that opens the quote and takes free text, leading the field panel.

sort.description: The button that opens the list of columns the files sort by.

summary.defaultMessage: {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}, {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
summary.description: The counts of the folders and files the current folder shows, at the end of the browser's head.

actions.description: The button on a file or folder that opens its actions.

empty.description: Shown when the current folder holds neither files nor folders.

noMatches.description: Shown when a search of the current folder matches neither files nor folders.

noFiles.description: Shown in the file list when the current folder holds folders but no files.

clear.description: The button that clears the selected files.

root.description: The label of the root crumb: the first entry of the browser's trail, above every folder.
